lines.en: label ayanedorm35:
I knock on Ayane’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ayane 的门，等她来开门。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: scene black
She answers right away and entering her room is an incredibly easy process without any additional banter or internal monologuing.
lines.zh: 她立刻就应了声，走进她的房间顺利得不可思议，没有多余的拌嘴，也没有内心独白。

lines.en: I wish opening every door was this easy.
lines.zh: 真希望每扇门都这么好开。

lines.en: scene anormaldoor
There are some doors that you can never open again 61 6e 64 20 73 6f 6d 65 20 74 68 61 74 20 79 6f 75 20 63 61 6e 20 6e 65 76 65 72 20 63 6c 6f 73 65~~~~~~~~~~
scene ayanesanapark1
: Sensei! I’m so glad you decided to show up.
lines.zh: : Sensei！你居然真的来了，我太高兴了。
: 那个……你好……

lines.en: : Hey. What are you two up to tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你们俩今晚在忙什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just hanging around eating doughnuts and trying to convince Sana that Despacito is actually a really good song.
lines.zh: : 哦，就那样啦。一边吃甜甜圈一边晃悠，顺便说服 Sana 相信 Despacito 其实是一首很棒的歌。

lines.en: : Yes, I can see the doughnuts from here and they look entirely normal.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我从这儿就能看见甜甜圈，它们看起来完全很正常。

lines.en: : How is Sana faring with your weird Spanish music?
lines.zh: : Sana 对你那诡异的西班牙歌还扛得住吗？

lines.en: : I...have no idea what anyone is saying but...it isn’t the...worst?
lines.zh: : 我……完全听不懂在唱什么，但……也不算……最糟？

lines.en: : We were actually just thinking about other stuff to do since the site we normally use to watch movies is down and Sana won’t let me paint her nails.
lines.zh: : 我们其实正在想要干点别的，因为我们平时看电影的那个网站挂了，而且 Sana 不让我给她涂指甲。

lines.en: : I...don’t really want to take my gloves off...
lines.zh: : 我……不太想把手套摘下来……

lines.en: : Can I paint your nails instead, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那我给你涂指甲好不好，Sensei？

lines.en: : Absolutely not and I’m offended that you even asked.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行，你居然问得出口，我都被冒犯了。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark2
: Well...what should we do, then?
lines.zh: : 那……我们该干点什么呢？

lines.en: : It’s still not super late and I don’t want to just spend the rest of the night sitting around listening to Despacito.
lines.zh: : 现在还不算太晚，我可不想剩下的一整晚都坐着听 Despacito。

lines.en: : Yeah...four nights a week would be a little excessive...
lines.zh: : 是啊……一周四晚的话有点太多了……

lines.en: : Ayane, are you forgetting that the king of fun is standing right here in front of you?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你是不是忘了，享乐之王现在就站在你面前？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark3
: Ahh, yes! I was so blinded by your handsomeness that I must have forgotten that you’re actually very exciting and full of good ideas!
lines.zh: : 啊，对哦！我被你的帅气晃花了眼，居然忘了你其实非常有趣、满脑子都是好点子！

lines.en: : Tone it down or it just sounds sarcastic.
lines.zh: : 收着点，不然听起来就像在讽刺。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark4
: Psht, don’t tell me how to live my life.
lines.zh: : 切，少来教我怎么活。

lines.en: : But do feel free to tell me how to spend my night because I wanna get out of here.
lines.zh: : 不过今晚怎么过你尽管说，因为我只想离开这个房间。

lines.en: : I kind of wanted to stay in...
lines.zh: : 我其实有点想待在屋里……

lines.en: : I...can leave if you two want to be alone...
lines.zh: : 我……可以走开的，如果你们俩想独处的话……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark5
: What? No way. You’re in on this too, Sana.
lines.zh: : 什么？不行。这事也有你一份，Sana。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just ask you to leave because my future husband showed up.
lines.zh: : 我才不会因为我未来老公来了就把你赶走。

lines.en: : Really?...It’s okay?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……可以吗？……

lines.en: : Of course. And I’m sure Sensei’s not opposed either since you’re the cutest little cyclops in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 当然。而且我敢肯定 Sensei 也不会反对，毕竟你是 Kumon-mi 最可爱的小独眼巨人。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark6
: I...have two eyes, though...
lines.zh: : 可……我有两只眼睛啊……

lines.en: : Sure you do, Sana. Sure you do.
lines.zh: : 对对对，你说得对，Sana。你说得对。

lines.en: : So, any ideas?
lines.zh: : 那么，有什么主意吗？

lines.en: : The only thing that’s coming to my mind is the bathhouse.
lines.zh: : 我脑子里唯一冒出来的就是澡堂。

lines.en: : Yeah, about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到这个。

lines.en: : Io works there and it probably wouldn’t be smart for us to go there again.
lines.zh: : Io 在那儿工作，我们再过去大概不太明智。

lines.en: : Not even if we bathe on different sides and you just listen to us through the fence?
lines.zh: : 就算我们分两边洗，你只是隔着栅栏听我们说话也不行？

lines.en: : Been there, done that. It’s a lot harder than it sounds.
lines.zh: : 早就试过了。做起来比听起来难多了。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark7
: You’ve...done that before?
lines.zh: : 你们……以前干过这种事？

lines.en: : Sensei basically raised me. Of course he’s also tried listening to my voice through the fence of a bathhouse before. That’s just part of being a dad.
lines.zh: : Sensei 基本上就是把我带大的人。他当然也试过隔着澡堂的栅栏听我的声音啦。当爸爸本来就该这样。

lines.en: : If that’s true, I’m...kind of thankful I never really had one.
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样，我……有点庆幸自己从来没真正有过爸爸。

lines.en: : That’s extremely depressing and I’m going to pretend I never heard it.
lines.zh: : 这话丧得要命，我打算假装自己没听见。

lines.en: : The clock’s ticking, Sensei. Where are you going to take us lovely [young]ladies tonight?
lines.zh: : 时间不等人哦，Sensei。今晚你打算带我们这两位可爱的[young]女士去哪儿？

lines.en: I have no idea why it suddenly falls on me to plan a night out with these two...
lines.zh: 我真不知道为什么策划今晚出行的担子突然就落到了我头上……

lines.en: But if Ayane is really that determined to get out and it needs to be a place where none of the girls work-
lines.zh: 不过既然 Ayane 这么铁了心要出去，而且得是个这些女生都没在打工的地方——

lines.en: : Why not just go to the park?
lines.zh: : 干嘛不去公园？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark8
: Which one? Because the park closest to the dorms gets swarmed with bugs at night and they always bite me because they can sense that I have the blood of a warrior.
lines.zh: : 哪个？离宿舍最近那个公园一到晚上就被虫子围攻，而且它们总咬我，因为它们感觉得到我身上流着战士的血。

lines.en: : Then...we’ll go to the one near the[school].
lines.zh: : 那……就去[school]附近那个吧。

lines.en: : Doesn’t...the really cool looking girl in our class hang out at that park?
lines.zh: : 我们班那个……看起来很酷的女生，不是经常在那个公园晃吗？

lines.en: : Otoha? It’s past her bedtime right now. Her mom would probably kill her if she was out this late.
lines.zh: : Otoha？现在早过了她的睡觉时间。她要是这么晚还在外面，她妈大概会杀了她。

lines.en: : But it’s only like 7:00 PM.
lines.zh: : 可现在才晚上七点啊。

lines.en: : I said what I said.
lines.zh: : 我说什么就是什么。

lines.en: : So, does that work for you two? Or would you rather go hang out at Sara’s bar instead?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们俩觉得行吗？还是说你们更想去 Sara 的酒吧？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark9
: Park...please...
lines.zh: : 公园……拜托……

lines.en: : I don’t...really want to hang out with my mom when I’m not working...
lines.zh: : 我……不上班的时候真的不太想跟我妈待在一起……

lines.en: : I like Sara...but I like Sana more. So I’m fine with the park if that’s where everyone wants to go.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Sara……但我更喜欢 Sana。所以既然大家都想去公园，我没意见。

lines.en: : It’s a little cold, though, so sorry in advance if you have to keep me warm.
lines.zh: : 不过有点冷，所以要是你得负责给我暖身子，先说声抱歉啦。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’d feel a little bad leaving Sana to fend for herself, though.
lines.zh: : 没问题。不过把 Sana 一个人扔在那儿自生自灭，我会有点过意不去。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark10
: Oh...um...I’ll be okay...
lines.zh: : 啊……那个……我没事的……

lines.en: : You can...focus on Ayane...
lines.zh: : 你可以……专心照顾 Ayane……

lines.en: : I’m kind of...the third wheel for this anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正我本来就是……电灯泡……

lines.en: : I love you, Sana. Thank you for relinquishing Sensei to me.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，Sana。谢谢你把 Sensei 让给我。

lines.en: : Just one of his arms is big enough to cover me, though. So I wouldn’t really mind if he used to the other one to-
lines.zh: : 不过他一只胳膊就够把我裹住了。所以就算他用另一只胳膊去——我也不会介意啦。

lines.en: : I’m okay. Just...focus on Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我没事。就……专心对 Ayane 就好。

lines.en: : But you can-
lines.zh: : 可是你可以——

lines.en: : Ayane, please.
lines.zh: : Ayane，求你了。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark11
: So be it.
lines.zh: : 那就这样吧。

lines.en: : Sensei will use both of his arms to keep me warm and Sana will freeze to death...
lines.zh: : Sensei 会用两条胳膊给我取暖，而 Sana 会活活冻死……

lines.en: : But she will die as the best friend one could ever ask for.
lines.zh: : 但她会作为一个求之不得的最好朋友死去。

lines.en: : Hahah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: scene black
I shrug off the fact that Sana just turned down an easy opportunity to get closer to me and come to terms with only being able to embrace {i}one{/i} cute girl tonight.
lines.zh: 我不再去想 Sana 刚刚放弃了一个跟我亲近的大好机会这件事，并接受今晚只能抱{i}一个{/i}可爱女生的事实。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I expect to happen until we go outside.
lines.zh: 至少在出门之前，我以为会是这样。

lines.en: I can’t help but notice on the way that Ayane is walking a little further away from me than normal.
lines.zh: 路上我忍不住注意到，Ayane 跟我拉开的距离比平时远了一些。

lines.en: I’m not sure if she’s just in a weird mood or if she’s doing this for Sana's sake, but...
lines.zh: 我不确定她只是心情古怪，还是为了 Sana 才这样，不过……

lines.en: I don’t know. There’s probably not much of a point in wasting my energy trying to figure it out when she so often tries to keep the more serious parts of herself hidden.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。她总是把较为认真的那一面藏起来，我大概没必要浪费力气去猜。

lines.en: It’s entirely possible that even pointing this out is making a mountain out of a molehill-
lines.zh: 很有可能连把这件事挑明都算是小题大做——

lines.en: But honestly...I’m kind of cold myself.
lines.zh: 但说实话……我自己也有点冷。

lines.en: And I wouldn’t mind a small dose of body heat at the expense of making at least one person uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 而且哪怕要让至少一个人不自在，我也不介意分一点体温来用。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
We eventually make it to the park.
lines.zh: 我们总算到了公园。

lines.en: I’m not really sure how long it took us to get here, but it feels a lot darker than it did just an hour ago.
lines.zh: 我不太确定我们走了多久，但这里比起一小时前黑多了。

lines.en: I look over at the girls, who’ve already started their own conversation and taken off a good twenty feet or so ahead of me.
lines.zh: 我看向两个女生，她们已经聊开了，还领先了我足足二十英尺左右。

lines.en: I try to make sense of what they’re saying but am unable to do so over the buzzing of a streetlight and the occasional violent gust of wind.
lines.zh: 我试图听懂她们在说什么，可路灯的嗡嗡声和偶尔刮来的狂风让我一句也没听清。

lines.en: They make it all the way to a picnic table without me hearing a single word.
lines.zh: 她们一路走到野餐桌旁，我一个字都没听见。

lines.en: But I doubt they’re talking about anything important to begin with.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑她们本来就聊不出什么重要的事。

lines.en: They’re just being two close friends. Miles apart in personality but only several feet apart from each other in physical distance and circumstance.
lines.zh: 她们只是两个要好的朋友。性格天差地别，可实际距离与处境，彼此之间只隔着几英尺。

lines.en: One parent gone. One parent present.
lines.zh: 一个没了父亲或母亲。一个还在。

lines.en: But {i}how{/i} present, exactly?
lines.zh: 可到底{i}有多{/i}“在”呢？

lines.en: It makes me think about {i}my{/i} parents for a moment.
lines.zh: 这让{i}我{/i}想起自己的父母。

lines.en: What they’d think of me now.
lines.zh: 他们会怎么看现在的我。

lines.en: Their names or what they looked like.
lines.zh: 他们的名字，他们的长相。

lines.en: But nothing comes to mind.
lines.zh: 可什么都想不起来。

lines.en: Perhaps they never existed at all.
lines.zh: 也许他们根本就不曾存在过。

lines.en: Perhaps I’m just some weird creature formed from dropping a few things into a beaker.
lines.zh: 也许我只是往烧杯里丢了几样东西之后形成的某种奇怪生物。

lines.en: Like one of those sponges that soaks up water and eventually becomes something bigger.
lines.zh: 就像那种吸饱了水、最后变得大上一圈的海绵。

lines.en: I think we’re all a little bit like sponges.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们每个人都有点像海绵。

lines.en: Just, instead of water, we soak up emotions and experiences.
lines.zh: 只不过我们吸收的不是水，而是情绪和经历。

lines.en: And every once in a while, we wring ourselves out on those with less water in them.
lines.zh: 偶尔，我们会把自己拧干，浇到那些水分比我们少的人身上。

lines.en: They absorb our contents in kind.
lines.zh: 他们照单全收。

lines.en: And grow to resemble more of us than we ever imagined they would.
lines.zh: 然后变得比我们想象中更像我们自己。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark12
And then they smile and wipe it all away.
lines.zh: 然后他们微笑着，把这一切抹去。

lines.en: I see none of myself in Ayane when her vaginal cavity isn’t desperately making room for me.
lines.zh: 当 Ayane 的阴道没有拼命为我腾出空间的时候，我在她身上看不到半点自己。

lines.en: But she sees all of herself in me.
lines.zh: 可她在我身上看到了全部的自己。

lines.en: And I’m not going to make a sex joke this time because even the thought of it is enough to make me shudder.
lines.zh: 这次我就不开黄腔了，因为光是想想就够让我发抖的。

lines.en: But still.
lines.zh: 但尽管如此。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever seen the sky look so pretty before.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我从没见过这么好看的天空。

lines.en: : You’d think that all of the lights in this area would make the stars harder to see, but nope!
lines.zh: : 你以为这一带的灯光会让星星更难看清，才怪！

lines.en: : There they are in all of their glory.
lines.zh: : 它们就挂在那儿，光彩夺目。

lines.en: : If any of us knew anything about constellations, now would probably be a good time to talk about them.
lines.zh: : 要是我们有谁懂星座，现在大概正是聊一聊的好时机。

lines.en: : Anybody?
lines.zh: : 有人吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : I can...maybe find the little dipper if I...
lines.zh: : 我……也许能找到小熊座，如果我……

lines.en: : Wait...no.
lines.zh: : 等等……不行。

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: : If only Maya were here.
lines.zh: : 要是 Maya 在这儿就好了。

lines.en: : She’d be able to point out all of them and then give us history lessons on their names like some kind of weird girl out of a dating game.
lines.zh: : 她能把所有星座都指出来，还会像恋爱游戏里那种怪女生一样，给我们上一堂关于它们名字的历史课。

lines.en: : That...does sound like something Maya would do...
lines.zh: : 那……确实像 Maya 会做的事……

lines.en: : Maya aside, are you two happy now?
lines.zh: : 先不提 Maya，你们俩现在开心了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark13
: Super happy!
lines.zh: : 超级开心！

lines.en: : I was a little worried about the weather but, now that we’re in the light and I can finally start to warm up, I’m actually having a really good time.
lines.zh: : 我本来还有点担心天气，不过现在我们站在灯光下，我总算开始暖和起来了，其实玩得真的很开心。

lines.en: : Is my embrace not needed anymore?
lines.zh: : 那是不是不需要我抱你了？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark14
: Your embrace is {i}always{/i} needed, Sensei. I’m just trying to be considerate about the feelings of Sana here since seeing you hug me would make her jealous.
lines.zh: : 你的拥抱{i}永远{/i}都需要，Sensei。我只是顾及一下 Sana 的感受，毕竟看到你抱我，她会吃醋的。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark15
: Wha-?!
: No it wouldn’t!
lines.zh: : 才不会呢！

lines.en: : I even said it was fine if you did the thing!
lines.zh: : 我还说了你们那样做也没关系呢！

lines.en: : My vote is for one giant group hug where we all rub up against each other so hard that the friction starts a fire that burns the park down and we all get sent to jail.
lines.zh: : 我投一票：来个超级大抱抱，大家互相蹭得那么用力，摩擦生火把公园烧了，然后我们一起进监狱。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna go to jail!
lines.zh: : 我不要进监狱！

lines.en: : I also support the friction idea.
lines.zh: : 我也赞成摩擦这个方案。

lines.en: : We’re all waiting on you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我们都等你呢，Sana。

lines.en: : But...I...the...friction...
lines.zh: : 可……我……那个……摩擦……

lines.en: : Bad!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark16
: Huh?
: Text message?
lines.zh: : 短信？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...no one ever texts me this late...
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……从来没人这么晚还给我发短信……

lines.en: : Or...in general...
lines.zh: : 或者……根本就没人给我发……

lines.en: : I’ll text you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我可以给你发啊，Sana。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark17
: No thank you!
lines.zh: : 不用了谢谢！

lines.en: : It...just looks like it’s my mom anyway...
lines.zh: : 而且……看起来就是我妈发的……

lines.en: : What does she want?
lines.zh: : 她找你什么事？

lines.en: : She...wants me to call her...
lines.zh: : 她……想让我给她打个电话……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark18
: Which...I probably should, since...she never asks me to do that...
lines.zh: : 我……大概确实该打，因为……她从来没让我这么做过……

lines.en: : I’m sorry...this will just take a minute...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……就耽误一小会儿……

lines.en: : I hope...
lines.zh: : 希望吧……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark19
: Umm...hi...
: Did you...need something?...
lines.zh: : 你……找我有什么事吗？……

lines.en: : New employee?
lines.zh: : 新来的员工？

lines.en: : Yeah...I can train her...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可以带她……

lines.en: : Are you...really able to hire someone, though?...
lines.zh: : 不过……你真的请得起人吗？……

lines.en: : Oh.
: Is that...legal?
lines.zh: : 那样……合法吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark20
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Then...yeah...
: I’ll come over...tomorrow night...
lines.zh: : 我明天晚上……过去一趟……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark21
: I don’t want to say it back...I’m with Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我不想说回去……我跟 Ayane 在一起呢……

lines.en: : Just...I’ll see you tomorrow...
lines.zh: : 总之……明天见……

lines.en: scene black
Sana hangs up the phone and breathes a sigh of relief, having just escaped the deadly clutches of a rather competent Sara given the time of day.
lines.zh: Sana 挂断电话，如释重负地松了口气——在这个时间点，她算是逃出了那个状态意外清醒的 Sara 的魔爪。

lines.en: Typically, I’d expect her to be passed out with a glass of wine or a sex toy in her hand by now.
lines.zh: 按理说，这个时候她应该已经手里攥着一杯葡萄酒或者一根按摩棒昏睡过去了。

lines.en: But I’m glad to hear that the thing with who I assume is Yuki is proceeding smoothly.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴听到，我猜是 Yuki 的那件事进展顺利。

lines.en: It seems someone else is a little upset about the call, though.
lines.zh: 不过看来还有一个人因为这通电话有点不太高兴。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark22

Sana and I immediately sense the sudden shift in Ayane’s mood...But it’s not something that either of us deserves any praise for because it’s about as subtle as a {s}hideous car wreck{/s} crash of thunder.
lines.zh: Sana 和我立刻察觉到 Ayane 的情绪突然变了……但这不值得我们任何一方被夸奖，因为那变化微妙得就像一场{s}惨烈的车祸{/s}撞上雷鸣。

lines.en: It’s the kind of look that still manages to leak out a bit of hope or...strained joy or...something that’s there to say “There is still more of me.”
lines.zh: 那是这样一种表情：仍会不小心漏出一丝希望，或者……强撑的喜悦，或者……某种在说“我还有更多没拿出来”的东西。

lines.en: “I am not down for the count yet.”
lines.zh: “我还没被击倒。”

lines.en: : I miss my mom.
lines.zh: : 我想我妈妈了。

lines.en: Or that.
lines.zh: 或者是这个。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark23
: Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : I’m...sorry...
lines.zh: : 我……对不起……

lines.en: : I should have walked away or-
lines.zh: : 我应该走开点的，或者——

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark24
: Oh! No no no no! It’s not your fault!
lines.zh: : 啊！不不不不！不是你的错！

lines.en: : Honestly...I’ve been thinking about her a lot lately. The end of your call just kind of pushed me over the edge.
lines.zh: : 说实话……我最近一直在想她。你那通电话的结尾只是把我推过了临界点。

lines.en: : Is that why you’ve been constantly telling everyone you’re not feeling well?
lines.zh: : 所以你才一直跟所有人说自己身体不舒服？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark25
: I’m going to take your silence as a yes.
lines.zh: : 我就当你的沉默是默认了。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark26
: Being a mom...sounds really hard.
lines.zh: : 当妈妈……听起来好难。

lines.en: : Everything can be totally fine and then...just go completely wrong out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 明明一切都好好的，然后……突然就全乱套了。

lines.en: : Even Sara is amazing to me because she’s able to keep going after all she’s been through.
lines.zh: : 连 Sara 在我看来都很了不起，因为她经历了那么多还能继续走下去。

lines.en: : Like, wouldn’t it be so much easier to just run away?
lines.zh: : 你说，干脆逃走不是轻松多了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark27
: I’m sorry for bringing the mood down all of a sudden! It’s just...you know, one of those things.
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然把气氛搞得这么沉重！只是……你知道，就是那种事。

lines.en: : Like, parenting in general is something I shouldn’t really talk about because...neither of mine seemed to want me and...
lines.zh: : 就是说，为人父母这种事本来不该由我来谈，因为……我那两个人看起来都不想要我，而且……

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark28
: Ugh...damn it.
lines.zh: : 呃……该死。

lines.en: : I told myself I wasn’t going to cry.
lines.zh: : 我跟自己说好了不哭的。

lines.en: : You can cry if you want. Neither of us are going to think any less of you for it.
lines.zh: : 想哭就哭吧。我们俩谁都不会因此看轻你。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark29
: I refuse!
lines.zh: : 我拒绝！

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark30
: Why should I cry because I had two parents who weren’t able to understand how beautiful and talented and smart I am?
lines.zh: : 我有那么漂亮、那么有才华、那么聪明，那两个人却不懂，我凭什么要为他们哭？

lines.en: : That’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 这不公平。

lines.en: : They should be the ones crying, not me.
lines.zh: : 该哭的是他们，不是我。

lines.en: : Which is why I’m going to be the best mom ever.
lines.zh: : 所以我要成为史上最好的妈妈。

lines.en: : And...even if the dad...cough cough {i}Sensei{/i}, doesn’t want to be a part of it, I’ll do it all on my own.
lines.zh: : 而且……就算那个爸爸……咳咳，{i}Sensei{/i}，不想掺和，我一个人也能全搞定。

lines.en: : I think you’re supposed to actually cough and not just say “cough cough.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得“咳咳”应该是真的咳嗽一声，而不是把“咳咳”念出来。

lines.en: : Also, don’t decide on your own that I’m going to be the father of your children.
lines.zh: : 还有，别自己一个人就决定我要当你孩子的爸。

lines.en: : They’ll be {i}your{/i} children too, Sensei! Whether you like it or not!
lines.zh: : 他们也会是{i}你的{/i}孩子，Sensei！不管你愿不愿意！

lines.en: : Is that a threat?
lines.zh: : 这是在威胁我吗？

lines.en: : I want to keep crying, but...this is getting...kind of weird...
lines.zh: : 我本来还想继续哭的，可是……这变得……有点奇怪了……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark31
: It’s not a threat...
lines.zh: : 这不是威胁啦……

lines.en: : I’m just saying that...I’m going to be a mom one day.
lines.zh: : 我只是在说……总有一天我会当妈妈的。

lines.en: : It’s going to happen.
lines.zh: : 这事一定会发生。

lines.en: : And when it does, I won’t need your help.
lines.zh: : 到那时候，我不需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say I don’t {i}want{/i} your help.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我不{i}想{/i}要你帮忙。

lines.en: : I think you’d be a great father since you were always there for me when mine wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你会是个很棒的父亲，因为我爸不在的时候，一直都是你在。

lines.en: : Just...I won’t {i}need{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 只是……我不会{i}需要{/i}。

lines.en: : But please give it to me.
lines.zh: : 但还是请你给我吧。

lines.en: : I don’t like this conversation.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个话题。

lines.en: : I...don’t either...
lines.zh: : 我……也不喜欢……

lines.en: : This is really weird...
lines.zh: : 这真的好奇怪……

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark32
: Do you believe in me, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你相信我吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Do you think I can do it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我做得到吗？

lines.en: : Why does it matter what I think or believe if you’ve already decided?
lines.zh: : 既然你已经决定了，我的想法和相信有什么要紧？

lines.en: : You don’t need me, remember?
lines.zh: : 你不需要我，记得吗？

lines.en: : Just tell me you believe in me and I’ll save the whole motherhood thing for another time.
lines.zh: : 你就说你相信我，我就把当妈这整套话题留到下次再说。

lines.en: : Why does this have to be a recurring topic? Sana and I desperately want to escape this right now.
lines.zh: : 为什么这非得是个反复出现的话题？Sana 和我现在拼命想逃。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark33
: There is no escape from Ayane Amamiya and her unnamed baby!
lines.zh: : 你们别想从 Ayane Amamiya 和她那个还没取名的宝宝手里逃掉！

lines.en: : At least give it a name before you start including it in your battle cries.
lines.zh: : 至少先给它取个名字，再把它写进你的战吼里。

lines.en: : Please just tell her...you believe in her, so...we can go home...
lines.zh: : 求你就告诉她……你相信她吧，这样……我们就能回家了……

lines.en: : Listen to the loli, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 听听这位 loli 的话吧，Sensei！

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark34
: Ayane! You know I don’t like it when you call me that!
lines.zh: : Ayane！你知道我不喜欢你这么叫我！

lines.en: : But you’re so cute and precious and just being around you makes me want to scream.
lines.zh: : 可你又可爱又珍贵，光是待在你身边我就想尖叫。

lines.en: : That has nothing to do with the nickname!
lines.zh: : 那跟这个外号有什么关系啊！

lines.en: : I believe in you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark35
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I doubt it’s worth anything, but-
lines.zh: : 我怀疑这话也没什么分量，不过——

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark36
: It is.
lines.zh: : 有的。

lines.en: : And I won’t let you down.
lines.zh: : 而且我不会让你失望。

lines.en: : Great. Just know now that I’m still opposed to impregnating you and-
lines.zh: : 很好。现在先说清楚，我依然反对让你怀孕，而且——

lines.en: : We’ll see about that!
lines.zh: : 那可说不定！

lines.en: : No. Stop saying that.
lines.zh: : 不。别再说这种话了。

lines.en: : I really {i}really{/i} don’t like this...
lines.zh: : 我真的{i}真的{/i}好不喜欢这样……

lines.en: : Great. Now Sana is jealous and wants you to give {i}her{/i} a baby.
lines.zh: : 太好了。现在 Sana 吃醋了，也想让你给{i}她{/i}一个宝宝。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark37
: I really {i}really{/i} {b}really{/b} really don’t want that!
lines.zh: : 我真的{i}真的{/i}{b}真的{/b}真的不想要！

lines.en: : Sana, I know it’s not intentional, but you’ve made me feel really bad about myself on several occasions tonight.
lines.zh: : Sana，我知道你不是故意的，但今晚你好几次都让我对自己感觉糟透了。

lines.en: : I can...almost promise you I feel worse!
lines.zh: : 我……几乎可以保证，我比你还难受！

lines.en: : There it is again.
lines.zh: : 又来了。

lines.en: : You’re breaking my heart.
lines.zh: : 你这是在伤我的心。

lines.en: : I’ll fix you up, Sensei. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我会把你修好的，Sensei。别担心。

lines.en: : And sorry for turning our fun night out into a smorgasbord of sadness.
lines.zh: : 还有，抱歉把我们的开心之夜变成了一桌悲伤自助餐。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I do feel a lot better now.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我现在确实好受多了。

lines.en: : Well, as long as {i}one{/i} person leaves here tonight feeling good.
lines.zh: : 行吧，只要今晚有{i}一个{/i}人是带着好心情离开的。

lines.en: scene ayanesanapark38
: I can promise you at least that much...
lines.zh: : 至少这一点我可以向你保证……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us make our way back to the dorm and it takes Sana a full five minutes to relearn how to speak.
lines.zh: 我们三人往宿舍走，Sana 花了整整五分钟才重新学会怎么说话。

lines.en: Ayane goes back to walking just as close to me as she always does.
lines.zh: Ayane 又恢复成平时那样紧挨着我走了。

lines.en: And then wraps her arms around me for even longer than usual when I drop them off.
lines.zh: 我送她们到门口时，她抱我的时间比平时还要久。

{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]！{/i}
